short: A machine that splits water into hydrogen and oxygen using electricity.
The core of an electrolyser: many cells pressed together where the splitting happens.
Splitting water with electricity. Green hydrogen in India is mostly made this way.
The liquid or membrane that carries charge between the electrodes in a cell.
Greenhouse gas emitted per kilogram of hydrogen, in kg CO₂ equivalent.
How much energy a fuel holds per kilogram or per litre.
one contractor designs, buys and builds a plant.
Fuels such as e-methanol made from green hydrogen and captured carbon.
the average cost to produce one kilogram over a plant's life, including equipment, power and upkeep.
formula: LCOH = (equipment cost + lifetime running costs + lifetime power cost, all discounted) ÷ lifetime kilograms produced
formulaNote: Unit: ₹/kg or US$/kg of hydrogen. State whether it includes compression, storage and GST when comparing figures.
